typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{Carrier Member ID} as string,
		{Member Phone} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	format: 'table',
	staged:false) ~> ExcelFile
ExcelFile derive(MemberID = rtrim(toString({Carrier Member ID}),' '),
		Phone = replace(replace(replace(replace(rtrim(toString({Member Phone}),' '), toString('-'), toString('')), toString('('), toString('')), toString(')'), toString('')), toString(' '), toString(''))) ~> TrimFields
TrimFields derive(MemberID_NonUnicode = toString(MemberID),
		Phone_NonUnicode = toString(Phone)) ~> ConverttoNonUnicode
ConverttoNonUnicode sink(input(
		SIMPLYHEALTH_DONOTCALL_PHONE as string,
		SIMPLYHEALTH_DONOTCALL_MEMBERID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		SIMPLYHEALTH_DONOTCALL_PHONE = Phone_NonUnicode,
		SIMPLYHEALTH_DONOTCALL_MEMBERID = MemberID_NonUnicode)) ~> PDSSIMPLYHEALTHDONOTCALL
